market: Europe Waterborne Polyurethane Dispersion Adhesives Market
market_definition: The waterborne polyurethane dispersion adhesives market comprises low-VOC adhesives based on polyurethane polymers dispersed in water, often cross-linked with isocyanates. It measures sales of finished one- and two-component dispersion adhesives. BY DISPERSION TYPE: Anionic, Non-Ionic, Cationic. BY CROSS-LINKING: Non-Crosslinked, Isocyanate-Crosslinked, Other Crosslinking. BY POLYOL BASE: Polyester, Polyether, Polycarbonate. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Footwear & Leather, Automotive Interiors, Flexible Packaging Lamination, Textiles & Furniture, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Solvent-borne and 100%-solids polyurethane adhesives; polyurethane dispersions for coatings; polyurethane foams. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms. GEOGRAPHY OF THIS LIST: EUROPE - companies headquartered in a European country (EU, United Kingdom, EFTA, Western Balkans, Ukraine, Moldova, Russia).
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. PRODUCT SCOPE (required): "polyurethane" AND ("MDI" OR "TDI" OR "polyol" OR "isocyanate" OR "foam" OR "elastomer") AND ("distributor" OR "wholesaler"). Qualifying: MDI/TDI isocyanates, polyols, PU systems and prepolymers, flexible/rigid PU foam, PU elastomers, adhesives, sealants, coatings, TPU resins. EXCLUDE general chemical distributors with no named PU line, furniture/mattress retailers, and PU machinery suppliers. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
